## Checklist

- [ ] runs without errors
- [ ] `make check` green (ruff format --check + ruff check + pytest)
- [ ] mypy clean
- [ ] tested manually
- [ ] new behaviour ships with at least one test
- [ ] no regressions on existing features
- [ ] rebased on latest `main` (resolving conflicts before opening the PR is the opener's responsibility)
- [ ] no sensitive data or secrets committed (`gitleaks` green)
